scope: Exact quantum-vacuum-centered radial trace source/response; complete paired Dirac normal-smearing coefficient and its finite-cut obstruction; AdS boundary limit in the forced scalar response class.

primary_sources.read: Section 5.3, mixed coefficient (5.33), all normal-smearing rows; section 5.2 normal convention
primary_sources.use: Input mixed heat formula only. The rank-eight paired projector, Robin and Clifford traces are derived/rechecked, including both partner domains. No smooth-boundary theorem is applied directly to the nonsmooth compactified response.

closest_comparator: Previous charged bulk comparison, and established mixed heat-coefficient theorem. This result computes the actual trace source after exact recentering, its continuum energy response, and the previously missing non-angle normal heat rows.
hardest_steps: Continuum coercivity and source admissibility in the complete-end energy space, not sampled matrix positivity.
Regular-singular asymptotics exclude energy-inadmissible modes and determine the nonzero forced logarithm; no amplitudes of the remaining admissible modes are assigned zero.
Finite-cut Dirac boundary variation is nonzero on local metric/curvature Dirichlet tangents; this is not promoted to a physical finite-cut realization.
The actual AdS scalar boundary limit uses smooth finite cuts and finite-jet power counting. Shape variations, a full nonlinear domain, and rough determinant differentiability remain open.
